text:
tia: quick triage pls — support reports a customer seeing duplicate token billing when a stream reconnects and a toolcall is truncated mid-retry. anyone seen this pattern before?

lee: do we have a request id / minimal logs to start?

tia: req_20260310_7. sanitized snippet:
```json
{
  \"session_id\": \"sess_77\",
  \"req_id\": \"req_20260310_7\",
  \"provisional_tokens\": 75,
  \"resume_to\": \"us-west-2-b\",
  \"toolcall_truncated\": true,
  \"confirmed_tokens\": 180
}
```

maria: my read: provisional allocation on original host wasn't cleared before the resumed host confirmed a larger/truncated final ack. we should tag ledger rows with provisional_id + resumed_from_session to join.

sam: ok. i'll add a router header `x-resume-session` and emit telemetry fields: `provisional_id`, `provisional_route`, `confirmed_route`, `toolcall_truncated`. will push a small runtime patch to set `toolcall_truncated=true` on truncation paths.

lee: console/UI idea: surface an "in-flight provisional" row in the per-request waterfall and highlight when provisional and confirmed routes differ. support needs that.

ops-bot: Incident INF-3201 created: "resume+truncation suspected double-charge" (owner: eng-platform)

maria: propose a conservative reconcile rule: if `provisional_route != confirmed_route` AND `toolcall_truncated=true` AND `confirmed_tokens >= provisional_tokens * 2` => flag for manual review. we can tune multiplier later.

sam: repro plan: force disconnect during toolcall, resume to different shard, force truncation. i'll run harness and attach trace id when done.

tia: action items: sam - headers+telemetry+runtime tag; lee - provisional row UI (feature-flagged); maria - analytics join keys & queries; sam/danny - repro harness+trace. post traces here.

sam: reproduced locally, trace trace_20260310_local_3 uploaded to infra logs.

maria: once telemetry lands i'll run a 24h query to see scope and share results. finance/support: likely want an audit path for affected customers.

tia: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene if the query shows wide impact.
